name: Wand of Secrets
description: A short wand of dark wood that quivers near hidden things.
body:
## What it does

Spend a charge as an action and, if a secret door or a trap lies within 30 feet, the wand pulses and points to the nearest.

## Charges

It holds three and regains 1d3 each dawn.

features.name: Secrets
features.text: 1 charge: it points at the nearest secret door or trap within 30 feet.
